idea-plugin.name: Cranpose
idea-plugin.description:
Cranpose development tools for IntelliJ IDEA and RustRover, with a tool window written in Cranpose.

  • Discover Cargo workspace binaries and examples that use Cranpose.
  • Check, run and test targets with build output in the IDE.
  • Code / Split / Preview editors with compiled component fixtures, viewport controls and PNG export.
  • Live layout trees, element picking, bounds, modifier properties and navigation to composable origins.
  • Persistent Cargo run configurations and automatic preview rebuilds on save.
  • Composable gutter markers, source navigation and component completions.
  • Create a working Cranpose application in an empty project.

Install JetBrains Rust support for full Rust language editing. Preview applications need Cranpose's preview feature. See the repository for setup and supported framework revisions.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.2: previews beside source, registered component variants, live layout inspection with picking and source origins, persistent run configurations, viewport scaling and image export. Failed builds preserve the last successful preview.
